htdocs_dir.description: Root directory from which files are served.

bind_addr.description: Network address the server binds to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 or ::).

port.description: TCP port the server listens on.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker threads for handling requests.

index_files.description: List of filenames to serve when a directory is requested.

enable_dirlist.description: If true, show file listing when no index file is present.

enable_gzip.description: If true, enable GZIP compression for text-based responses.

custom_mime_types.description: List of custom MIME type mappings (file extension → MIME type).

mime.description: MIME type to associate with the extension (e.g., image/svg+xml, image/webp)

access_log.description: Path to the access log file. Leave empty to disable access logging.

error_log.description: Path to the error log file. Leave empty to disable error logging.

name.description: Logical name for the virtual host (used for logging and configuration clarity).

server_name.description: Domain name(s) this virtual host responds to (e.g., example.com, *.example.org). Optional.

document_root.description: Root directory for this virtual host. Overrides global htdocs_dir if set.

index_files.description: List of index files for this virtual host. Overrides global index_files if set.

enable_dirlist.description: Override global directory listing setting for this host. If omitted, inherits global setting.

ssl_enabled.description: If true, enable TLS/SSL for HTTPS support.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if ssl_enabled is true.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if ssl_enabled is true.
